forge_default_tag_closure.method: Native compiled tag-builder statements and transitive BlockTags references; not runtime mod/datapack tags.

positive_scope: All three road methods, not just sample positions, correspond after enumerated API/height substitutions.
Ten rail material identity/speed/resistance declarations correspond to original normal-track rows after case normalization.
Worldgen metadata axis/reflector conversion and model variants cover generated stripe states; texture files exist.
The two half-chunk terrain sampling plane is above the tunnel roof; the bounded sequential-half probe does not support a false road-mode inconsistency claim.
limits: Returned rail caps are not final observed cart speed. Native entity integration and actual world loading remain untested.
Wood witness uses default vanilla/GT tag definitions. Datapacks or mods may change membership; no universal claim for every installation.
The two private helpers have no ordinary owner-source references beyond their declarations; arbitrary reflective access is not excluded.
No full Gradle/mod compile, GameTest, game, render, saved-world restart, build, push or GitHub message.
